versions.subject: Remove implicit selection number, first Sysmon example
versions.detection:
selection:
    - EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
      EventID: 1
      ParentImage: '*\mmc.exe'
      Image: '*\cmd.exe'
exclusion:
    - CommandLine: '*\RunCmd.cmd'
condition: selection and not exclusion
